title: Connect your social accounts
blurb: Link Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and Google Business.

steps.title: Open Social Planner
steps.body: Click **Social Planner**. This is where you connect your accounts and schedule posts.

steps.title: Pick your networks
steps.body: These are the networks you can connect. You can add or remove any of them later.

steps.title: Start with Facebook
steps.body: Click **Connect** on Facebook. Log in with the Facebook profile that has **full control** of your business Page, and choose **Opt in to all current and future Pages** when asked.
steps.tip: Page list comes up empty? You need full control of the Page. Email hello@luubu.com and we'll sort it with you.

steps.title: Add the rest the same way
steps.body: Repeat for **Instagram**, **LinkedIn**, **TikTok** and **GBP** (your Google Business Profile). Each one opens a login window. Sign in and allow access.
steps.tip: Instagram must be a Business or Creator account linked to your Facebook Page.
